result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the circular action button in the top-right header is missing its icon, showing only a blank gray circle with a red notification dot.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header (opposite the delivery address) renders as an empty light-gray circle with a red badge dot, missing its central icon (e.g., notifications bell or cart icon).
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon asset or vector inside the top-right header button loads properly and has sufficient contrast against the light-gray circular background.
